method: Browser UI and WebMCP checks on the local preview, using real MapLibre rendering and static HALC assets.

checks.name: Desktop restored dossier
checks.details: HALC fid 9088 restores from URL at year 1500; original Antwerpen/BR5000A, Holy Roman Empire, Brabant, TYPE 0 and 2.6123 km² match source attributes.

checks.name: Dossier tabs isolate arrow keys
checks.details: Sources to original fields and back through left/right arrow keys; year 1500 and camera [4.4,51.22,10.2,0,0] unchanged.

checks.name: Desktop panel inside map
checks.details: Side-positioned panel is wholly visible; heading, close control, all overview rows remain within map.

checks.name: Mobile source reading
checks.details: Panel bounds x20–370,y90.5–610.5. Width and scrollWidth both 350px; source text wraps, internal vertical scrolling available.

checks.name: English record
checks.details: Record, Sources and Original fields tabs; translated attributed polity/region/type; source place name retained.

checks.name: Year fallback and exploration
checks.details: Moving from 1500 to 1501 clears HALC record and labels, retains mode, shows global overview. Explore button returns to 1500, center [4.8,51.3], zoom7 and active HALC.

checks.name: Unsupported year request gate
checks.details: Observed Network.requestWillBeSent from initial navigation to settled year1501; zero /data/halc/ requests.

checks.name: Hidden boundary request gate
checks.details: Observed initial URL year1500,borders=0,boundaries=halc; zero /data/halc/ requests.

checks.name: Comparison selected record restoration
checks.details: Left overview/right HALC, both year1500. boundary=halc:9088&side=right restores to dialog parent map2; source preferences remain independent.

checks.name: Browser console
checks.details: No captured warning/error entries during final comparison inspection.

limits: The source data reconstruct the Low Countries in 1500; no Alpine precision claim is made.
These checks establish observed UI behavior, not a historical accuracy guarantee.
Request gates are separate from the mocked lifecycle suite; no global performance benchmark is claimed.
